question: Should exact pre-approval previews and proposal-version-bound decisions become a supported core Skill Workshop workflow?
rationale: The implementation and proof are strong, but this adds a substantial user-facing core action and intentionally changes approval behavior when a proposal is revised during the approval wait.

options.title: Adopt the complete flow
options.body: Accept exact previews and additive proposal-version binding as the supported Skill Workshop review workflow.

options.title: Adopt preview only
options.body: Land the canonical read-only review action but defer version-bound lifecycle decisions.

options.title: Keep current approvals
options.body: Retain inspect and prose summaries without adding the new review action or lifecycle parameter.

recommendation.title: Adopt the complete flow
recommendation.body: Accept exact previews and additive proposal-version binding as the supported Skill Workshop review workflow.

likelyOwner.reason: The current assignee is the best available owner for the live product-direction decision, with steipete providing strong source-history context.
